title:
`ReliabilityRiskMl.Scaler` is an abstract type used to define a scaling mechanism for features
in the context of reliability risk models. It provides a common interface for scaling techniques
that can be applied to input features before they are fed into a machine learning model for risk
scoring or other tasks related to reliability risk prediction.

Scalers help ensure that the input features are normalized or standardized in a way that improves
the performance and stability of machine learning models. Common scalers include min-max scaling,
standardization, and others.
name: ReliabilityRiskMl.Scaler
